test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

The soldier said to his fellow soldiers, "I have buried our brave comrade here

options.text: The soldier told his fellow soldiers that he had buried their brave comrade there.
The soldier told us that I had buried their brave comrade here.
The soldier told his fellow soldiers that I had buried our brave comrade there.
The soldier told us that he had buried our brave comrade there.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The soldier told his fellow soldiers that he had buried their brave comrade there.
 
• **Direct to Indirect Speech:** 
 
 
• **Pronoun Change:** 
 
 
• "I" is changed to "he" to match the subject of the reporting verb.
 
• "our" is changed to "their" to align with the perspective of the fellow soldiers.
 
 
 
• **Tense Change:** 
 
 
• "have buried" is changed to "had buried" to signify that the action is being reported in the past.
 
 
 
• **Word Change:** 
 
 
• "here" is changed to "there" to properly reflect the change in location when reporting.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• No quotation marks are used in indirect speech.
 
• The reporting clause "The soldier told his fellow soldiers that..." starts the sentence.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The soldier told his fellow soldiers that he had buried their brave comrade there."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "The soldier told us that I had buried their brave comrade here."

 
 
• Incorrectly changes the audience to "us" instead of "his fellow soldiers."
 
• Does not change "I" to "he," and "here" remains "here" instead of "there," which is not correct in reported speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "The soldier told his fellow soldiers that I had buried our brave comrade there."
 
 
• Does not change "I" to "he," and "our" remains "our" instead of "their," which is not correct in reported speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The soldier told us that he had buried our brave comrade there."
 
 
• Incorrectly changes the audience to "us" instead of "his fellow soldiers."
 
• "our" remains "our" instead of "their," which is not correct in reported speech.
